record.a: batik · tie-dye cloth · adire · bandhani · shibori
record.d: Cloth bought already patterned by resist dyeing, such as Javanese batik, whose locally made cloths out-competed Dutch chintz imports in the 17th century.

archetype.a: Javanese batik · batik tulis · batik cap
archetype.d: Wax-resist dyed cloth most highly developed on Java, Indonesia, made in regional styles such as the pesisir coastal batik of Pekalongan, Cirebon and Lasem.

v.d: north-coast Java style with Chinese and Indo-European influence
